content:
Apple today announced major Mac news, including brand new Mac Studio and Mac mini product lines.

If you're interested in getting your hands on the new Apple products announced today, you can now pre-order them on Amazon.

What's new today?

Here's everything you need to know about the latest Mac Studio and Mac mini updates: new chips (M6 and M5 Ultra), better performance, more configuration options, a host of AI optimisations, and more.

  • Apple unveils new Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro chips
  • Apple announces new Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra
  • Apple announces next-generation Apple Silicon chips: M6 and M5 Ultra

Buy on Amazon

Following this morning's announcement, Amazon has begun taking orders for Apple's new Mac mini and accessories.

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $899
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,099
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,699

Apple also made a small change to the Magic Keyboard today, and the new model is now available on Amazon:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard $99
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID $149
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Numeric Keypad (Black) $199

Buy on Best Buy

  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,599

Are you planning to pick up any of Apple's new products? Let us know in the comments.
